title: Anthropic CEO: "We Might Be 6 To 12 Months Away" From AI Doing A Software Engineer's Job
summary: Short clip of Dario Amodei predicting models will do most or all of an engineer's work within 6-12 months.

assertions.quote: we might be 6 to 12 months away from when the model is doing most, maybe all of what we used do end-to-end

verdicts.note: Prediction tracked against 2026 reality: agents handle more scoped tasks, but end-to-end engineering (requirements, review, operations) still depends on people; METR horizons and hiring data don't support 'most or all' yet.

assertions.quote: engineers within Anthropic who say, I don't write any code anymore

verdicts.note: Google and Microsoft executives cite ~25-50% of new code AI-generated; the figures are self-reported and usually count accepted suggestions, not finished code.
